correctness.rationale: Rank-k logical equivalence is exactly equality of capped one-point-type counts; independent multinomial counting proves the coefficient identity. The diagonal tilted distribution has a unique saddle for positive density; its support contains a full Z^2 lattice, variance is positive definite, and uniform bounded exponential moments give the centered 2D local CLT by Fourier inversion. Stirling yields the exact α/sqrt(detΣ) prefactor, and the rank-one critical saddle is t=log2 with stationary rate and covariance entries (t,t^2;t^2,t). An independent direct rational enumeration of 48 small cases and exact Stirling critical-ratio evaluation passed, without conflating finite tests with the universal proof.

value.rationale: The collision probability of two random monadic structures having identical bounded-rank theories is a natural model-theoretic probability invariant. The exact exponential and prefactor asymptotics refine an otherwise qualitative finite-model-theoretic equivalence relation and illustrate a nontrivial contact at density log2 between fixed-size and Poissonized rates. The two-dimensional aperiodic saddle proof is reusable for every fixed quantifier rank, with a motivated and quantitatively sharp phenomenon.
